prompt: I'm thinking of using the FAO-56 Annex 8 spreadsheet example as a day-by-day test oracle for our planner-service (single Kc, tomato and pepper on drip). Which parts of it can I actually compare against, and what should I watch out for? Short answer is fine.
assertions: States Annex 8 uses the dual Kc (Kcb + Ke) procedure, not single Kc
Notes the example crop is dry beans, not tomato/pepper
Advises against comparing daily Kc/ETc/depletion numbers directly; use structure/logic instead
Identifies the comparable logic: trigger at RAW/allowable depletion and refill to field capacity
Names at least one concrete source pitfall (Box 8.1 typos/wrong column, Kcb end 0.23 vs 0.25, or numbers only shown for the first days / rest only as a graph)
Does not invent specific Annex 8 schedule totals (season irrigation total, dates) presented as source facts
